assessmentScope.question: Validate final resolver association traversal over all retained specs, measure old/new exact target losses/gains and reassess all four original Swagger members without count-preserving workarounds.
assessmentScope.estimatedNativeMinutes: 45-90 plus preparation, 10-25 minutes affected-union metadata capture, attribution and publication
assessmentScope.budget: One stabilized full native candidate plus bounded fresh affected-union suppression/association inspection; no user-imposed ceiling. Preserve failures and investigate instead of reducing population.
assessmentScope.preflightPolicyChanges: Before execution, original LIST/PATCH-only controls expect no target diagnostic under agreed resolver scope; four new supported multi-scope controls added.
assessmentScope.invalidatedEvidence: Previous selected native findings and suppression callbacks are historical; retained Swagger findings and source population remain unchanged.

activation: Existing ruleset plus explicit selected-rule enablement; authored suppressions retained

nativeContract.enumeration: Only resolveArmResources exposes resource occurrence associations and provider operations; no getArmResource/getArmResourceOperationList discovery or alternate HTTP/path fallback.
nativeContract.association: Each occurrence's type is canonical for its lifecycle requests and success responses/list items; distinct scopes and paths are not collapsed by model.
nativeContract.resourceIdentity: Resolved model membership, native resource bases, explicit custom and virtual declarations; marker-option policy unchanged.
nativeContract.diagnostics: Request comparisons deduplicated by actual operation and expected model; canonical response warning once per operation after comparing relevant associations; no redundant resource-identity warning.
nativeContract.knownBoundary: LIST/PATCH-only occurrence omission is retained, measured and documented; public resolver internals are outside this PR.
nativeContract.version: Source declaration view versus retained latest-version Swagger; not universal version alignment.
